scope: Completed predeclared A0/B1/A0 using the same original release, same frozen driver, both owned headed CPUs throttled4, synthetic continuous Page-clock joystick, ordinary relay39±5 and identical graphics trace configuration. Twelve qualified desktop run bodies now retained across this series and the earlier nine-run comparison; qualification is not smoothness acceptance.

decision.reason: A1 was poor, B1 improved, and A2 also improved after the flag was removed. Reversible benefit of this single flag was not established.
notConcluded: All native wall time was CPU execution
Background compilation caused the adverse A1
Earlier recovery-tail or fixed earlier network-brake candidates validated
Steady60Hz or physical input-to-photon guarantee achieved
decision.qualifierErratum: A1 uses evidence-v2: the original root post-analysis treated a zero-count overflow object as a boolean. The original evidence and raw are preserved and metrics unchanged.
decision.teardown: All three pre-drain endpoints and trace windows qualified; all three later closed during/after the prolonged trace export and have teardownClean=false.
decision.progress: No additional browser run or production game change made during this offline decision analysis.

configuration.cadence: Absolute Page-clock grid throughout one held gesture; leg/control edges and terminal neutral retain their own deadlines.

captureFrameSubset180To1200.scope: Only conditionally attributed presented events with capture frame in [180,1200); this is not a denominator of all events due during the performance body.

maximumPageGapCallbacks.scope: Exactly (fromSample,toSample] from the strict linked timing evidence; includes the ending callback and excludes the completed starting callback. This differs from the timeline's half-open [start,end) post-sample context. Summed whole wall durations are not CPU self time.
